_comment_1: Trust policy for the GitHub Actions OIDC role. Placeholders are filled in by scripts/02-setup-github-oidc.sh (the _comment_* keys are stripped there; IAM ignores unknown top-level keys but we remove them anyway).
_comment_2: GitHub changed the OIDC subject format on 2026-07-15. The `sub` claim must now include the NUMERIC owner ID and repository ID: repo:<owner>@<OWNER_ID>/<repo>@<REPO_ID>:ref:refs/heads/<branch>. AWS's console-generated template still omits them, which fails with 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'. GitHub also recommends StringEquals over StringLike. Look the IDs up at https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo> (fields .owner.id and .id).
